Welcome to LV Cosy Apartments

Spacious, private and designed for a comfortable stay.

LV Cosy Apartments offers six furnished apartments in Fise, near Amasaman, Accra.

Each apartment accommodates up to four guests and includes a large furnished living room, fully equipped kitchen and two furnished en-suite bedrooms.
